messages:
cassie: Hey team — can someone take a look at PR #7510? Windows e2e keeps failing on CI with a GPU OOM intermittently, looks flaky.
rob: i'll check now, pinging @lee if you have context on windows infra
buildbot: [CI] Build #7510.3 failed — windows-e2e (gpu-node-7) — exit code 137
buildbot: failing step: run-windows-e2e
buildbot: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-10 14:22:11 ERROR: CUDA out of memory when allocating 512MB
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/run_e2e.py", line 342, in <module>
    run_tests()
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```
cassie: i tried re-running twice (rerun in GH), passes once then fails again. can't reproduce locally.
lee: could be a noisy node or a cache leak; did you try pinning batch_size smaller? also which commit introduced the change?
cassie: PR changes only affect model-serving config: reduced kv cache eviction window. CI runs on model-serving image `redwood-inference:stable-2026-03-05`
elaine: @cassie can you add `--batch-size 8` as an experiment in the test to see if it stabilizes? low-ram nodes flake with bigger batches
rob: if it's flaky we can mark the test as flaky for now with [flake] label and merge other fixes. but prefer to fix root cause.
cassie: ok i'll push a quick commit with reduced batch size and request rerun. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7510
lee: also add `retry: 2` to the workflow step to reduce noise for now
cassie: done — pushed 1790004200-quick-batch-fix, requested ci rerun :rocket:
rob: i'll keep an eye, if it still fails i'll try to repro on gpu-node-7 and report back
elaine: +1, thanks for the quick follow-up :thumbsup:
buildbot: [CI] Re-run requested by cassie — Build #7510.4 queued
cassie: thanks all — will update here with results
